biotools.summary: The EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (EEGmmidb) is a resource from PhysioNet containing EEG signals used for brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. The accompanying publication introduces a novel end-to-end EEG classification framework leveraging a pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network and Transformer for improved performance with reduced data and hardware requirements.
